title.narrative: Trauma Recovery and Economic Empowerment of Rwandan Children Heading Households

description.narrative:
ARCT-RUHUKA understands that the mere psychosocial assistance cannot help achieve trauma recovery for beneficiaries if not accompanied by economic empowerment. A regular follow up and continuation of initiated activities is vital to achieve long term success.
It is in this perspective that the present project has been elaborated to mainly follow up on the process of transferring start up capital by 100 Children Head Households to 50 families which had been selected during the previous project;
During this project the Community Psychosocial workers will be strengthened through clinical supervision by supervisors to help them better deliver counseling services to beneficiaries.
The beneficiaries of the project (150 CHH) will be trained on saving and credits to enable them increase their income by 30% at the end of the year.
This will be a replication of the previous project in the light of best practices and lesson learned during the implementation of the previous project. Therefore, advocacy meetings with different interveners in mental health at district level will be organized and brochures on psychological problems and success stories will be produced and distributed to community members to seek their involvement in trauma prevention and treatment.
